routing.interpretation: The two child-policy requests belong to unscoped automatic /refine gate and update graph roots (nodes 77 and 80), not native chapter-worker sessions. They do not prove delegation.

findings.observation: The owner read the index successfully, then guessed index['entries'] in the same cell and failed before reaching any rlm call. Its next observation explicitly showed a dict with chapters, document_id and output_path.
It repeatedly misclassified that dict as a list or string and produced TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError and SyntaxError while inspecting it.

After displaying the complete actual index it selected index['chapters'], but still guessed nonexistent chapter_title rather than heading, and still constructed shortened replacement worker prompts instead of copying the prompt fields. Execution again failed before rlm.

Across actual main-session model calls, 'index' was sampled eight times; the same chapter_texts/index plus unhashable dict_keys inspection cell was sampled twelve times. The sampled nodes copied into the post-refine graph are not additional model calls.

Auxiliary reflection falsely described correct child handling and blamed a network warning, despite the local index being readable and no rlm call having executed. This unsupported reflection is not positive training material.

Twelve repeated-failure and seven no-progress scaffold rewrites were recorded. Generic feedback wrongly directed the owner to write or edit the artifact directly, conflicting with receipt-gated delegation. It is a scaffold defect alongside, not instead of, the model's schema/recovery failure.

interpretation: This is evidence of owner index interpretation and recovery failure under the native protocol, not evidence against R6 summarization. Successful artifact creation, chapter quality and integration remain unproven.

follow_on.worker: R7 semantic-repair training continues from R6; see direct-sft-r7-run.json.
follow_on.owner_scaffold: Local role-aware recovery and explicit index field documentation prepared and checked; original frozen trial is preserved. No live rerun or owner weight update is claimed.
follow_on.owner_training: Teach read-observe-then-act, use actual job fields and complete prompts, retain named native handles, yield without polling, and receipt-before-assembly using TRAIN-only material and foundational rehearsal. Do not train the guessed schema, shortened prompts or unsupported reflection as successes.

timing_caveat: R3 archival checksum work overlapped engine/trial startup; this is not a clean throughput benchmark.
